case.pattern_description: The available evidence does not fit any established fraud pattern. The activity shows a cluster of online transactions on a device that has been used by many other cards, but no definitive sign of card testing, account takeover, or region-based abuse. As such, it remains an undocumented pattern.
case.summary: Three online purchases by the same customer on the same device, device used by many other cards, no prior fraud case, pattern evidence not matched, moderate risk score. Verdict is uncertain pending further investigation.
